metadata.body_format: KML 2.2 XML in namespace http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2; the response MIME type text/html is not treated as the document format.
metadata.independent_recapture: The 2026-10-09 root recapture is byte-identical to the research lane's 2026-09-26 capture at tmp/research-round42-india-parivesh/raiden-site.kml (same SHA-256 and length). The 2026-10-02 attempt failed at the network layer.
metadata.source_coordinate_string_sha256_method: SHA-256 of the nine whitespace-separated coordinate tuples of the selected LinearRing joined with single spaces (UTF-8), excluding leading and trailing whitespace.
metadata.source_vertex_count_note: Nine coordinate tuples: eight distinct vertices plus the closing repeat of the first.
metadata.source_altitudes: All zero; omitted from the 2D locator.
metadata.float_round_trip_check: Every source ordinate round-trips through a binary64 float to its identical source text, so the GeoJSON ordinates preserve source precision exactly.
metadata.validity: Valid simple polygon under Shapely 2.1.1; closed ring; no holes.
metadata.geodesic_area_method: pyproj 3.7.1 Geod(ellps='WGS84').geometry_area_perimeter on the source ring; diagnostic only.
metadata.ec_area_comparison: The polygon's 90,451.6 m2 is 116.4 m2 (0.13%) below SEIAA's plot area of 90,568 m2 and the CAF's total land of 9.0568 ha. PARIVESH's 'actual project area' of 89,672.4 equals the EC's FSI area, not a land area, and is not used. The source vertices are neither fitted nor corrected.
metadata.ec_coordinate_crosscheck: SEIAA's EC letter (PDF page 5, item 10) gives 19 degrees 3 minutes 19.57 seconds N, 73 degrees 1 minute 23.99 seconds E (about 73.0233306, 19.0554361; datum unstated). It lies inside the polygon, 0.10 m from the KML 'Raiden Project' point [73.02332998661491, 19.05543542204236] and 6.6 m from the display anchor. Neither point is selected.
metadata.caf_extent_crosscheck: The CAF record's cafKML ne_extend '19.05396419213783,73.02200465768205' and sw_extend '19.05688919921905,73.02479480436953' (latitude,longitude, with the minima stored under 'ne') equal the polygon's bounds digit for digit. The portal evidently derived them from this KML, so this binds the attachment to the CAF record rather than independently confirming the location.
metadata.corner_marker_placemarks: Eight 'Point 1' to 'Point 8' placemarks are corner markers, each 0.63-2.00 m from a distinct polygon vertex and not identical to it. They are not selected.
metadata.project_point_placemark: The 'Raiden Project' point lies inside the polygon; it is a cross-check only.

semantics.precision_scope: Exact source polygon vertices from the active CAF attachment's named plot boundary. SEIAA's EC site coordinate lies inside it and its geodesic area is within 0.13% of the EC plot area. A government-hosted proponent filing establishes a project-specific campus locator, not cadastral, surveyed or current-work-extent accuracy. The display anchor is the planar shoelace centroid of the source ring in source vertex order, verified inside it; it is not a publisher point, entrance or surveyed location.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: Neither the KML, the CAF nor the EC states a positional accuracy, survey method, geodetic realization or control points. Decimal count and government hosting do not establish accuracy.
